First time here? Three steps to start

Find a Rusted Warfare map file (.tmx). On phones it is usually in Internal storage / rustedWarfare / maps; on PC in the game's mods/maps folder (Steam: right-click the game in the library → Manage → Browse local files). If you have none, save one in the game or ask a friend.
Tap Open map below and pick it. The editor only takes the tile images from it as assets; your file is not changed or uploaded.
The assets are remembered on this device, so you can create new maps any time afterwards.
Why? The game's tile images are copyrighted and the editor does not ship them, so it needs one of your own maps to take them from.

For versus maps pick the symmetry first, then paint — the other half is painted at the same time.
When you finish, press “Playable?” — many problems can be fixed in one tap.
